root_schema: root.seed (signed int64), root.candidates (canonical legal-action indices); all other fields are metadata, never restore state
selection: First reachable boundary per seed and stage, including exploratory branches before choosing a turn. No filtering on continuation difficulty. Uniform sampling over families within eligible partition/stage. Stages with fewer than 20 families are diagnostic-only. No stage is released until original validation passes.
search_bias: True-future floor beam of 8 diverse builds, 4 outside-combat branches (24 at Neow), combat beam of 6 and 12 breadth or 16 extension turn samples. Up to 256 floor expansions with alternative floor beams retained. Emerald routing uses backward map reachability; sapphire reward and Act 3 recall are selected explicitly. First boundary observed on any branch is saved, including weak and later losing paths. Curse-transform preview choices are excluded because the original advances rule RNG as idle frames pass. No search result is a training label.
difficulty: 16 uniform legal continuations capped at 4096 decisions each; 4 search RNG streams capped at 16384 engine decisions each, combat beam of 6 and 4 samples. Continuations keep the same game RNG world. Success, death, other terminal, live budget cutoff and frame-dependent curse-preview censoring are separate metadata; zero success is not proof of impossibility. Uniform selection includes all legal actions and censors the continuation if it selects the unsupported preview. No difficulty filtering.

budget.cpu_accounting_note: Includes completed collector wrappers and recorded oracle/replay measurements. Initial compilation and some diagnostic commands were not timed separately; wall-clock budget is authoritative.

fresh_selection_rule.rule: Preserve original sample and families. Migrate the deferred-purge root from unchanged original scenario actions. Replace the frame-dependent curse-preview root by the closest HP-fraction root in the same partition/stage, excluding all already sampled families; apply the same structural eligibility rule to the whole pool.

search_attempt_accounting: Root-search attempts only; excludes scenario regressions and the 12-family pilot. Family sets include interrupted/faulted prefixes. Branch terminal counters overlap cloned routes and are not win-rate samples or training labels.

tail-breadth.rule: Use only families never attempted in the preceding allocation; resume the unchanged seed/prefix inputs. The earlier frozen collection passed native replay, complete difficulty measurement and reset_to in two minutes, allowing this bounded final allocation within the same three-hour budget.

tail-depth.rule: Use only families never attempted in the preceding allocation; resume the unchanged seed/prefix inputs. The earlier frozen collection passed native replay, complete difficulty measurement and reset_to in two minutes, allowing this bounded final allocation within the same three-hour budget.

latest.rule: Resume the furthest saved boundary, prioritizing Heart then Act 4 then Act 3. Include families already reaching Act 4 and unfinished Act 3 extension families. Exclude the independent concurrently collected extra-breadth families. Preserve every previously saved stage; no outcome/difficulty filtering.

latest-extra.rule: Use completed extra-breadth families only; the breadth collector never revisits them. Resume each furthest saved boundary and preserve all prior stage bits.

act3-resume.rule: After cheap furthest-boundary probes, resume the previously unattempted Act 3 extensions, from the original Act 3 entry prefix. Preserve all stages discovered by the furthest-boundary pass.

gaps: Death-terminal retained-card caches are not frame-independent in the original. Round 3 recorded 64 fresh focused scenarios plus seed 1000002317; four focused scenarios change only terminal AbstractCard.block between 14 and 10 with 13 extra idle frames, while all 1939 preterminal decisions remain byte-identical. Soul.update applies hand powers after a presentation-dependent flight; RestoreRetainedCardsAction restores reset cards without applying powers. A seed/action-only engine cannot satisfy both original snapshots under the frozen observation contract. No count threshold, snapshot exclusion, comparison change or presentation-RNG patch was applied. The original 183 replays remain 170 full passes and 13 terminal failures; release remains blocked.

Curse-transform preview paths fail the original 13-idle-frame invariant; excluded from roots and discovery without changing the RNG split or comparator. Uniform continuation draws that choose this path are censored and counted separately.
Original-game validation samples root prefixes; native replay and TrainingBatch.reset_to cover the full exported collection.
Difficulty rates are bounded continuation estimates in the same game RNG world. Cutoffs and censored continuations prevent interpreting zero success as impossibility.
The 12-family engineering pilot is costed but excluded from the final collection; round-one roots are not mixed into round-two coverage.

release_decision: Released 2026-10-17 on main. The 13 failing original replays differ only in the death-terminal AbstractCard.block of retained cards, which the original itself changes (14 vs 10) when 13 idle frames are added; all 93,550 preterminal decisions match in both scopes. Death ends the episode with zero reward, so the value never reaches a decision. Curse-transform preview paths remain excluded because the original advances rule RNG with idle frames. Independent check: fresh Release build, ctest 48/48, 846/846 traces, 12 deep traces.
